import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687599/attempts/9fae27520975411b8cb0cf3c60079e38/system/state/workspace/programs/task-1a4284c3.py'

code='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,7,9))\n    color=max(counts, key=counts.get)\n    return [[color]*3 for _ in range(3)]\n'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
